message.content:
Based on my search, here's information about making federal tax payments online:

## Main Online Payment Options for U.S. Federal Taxes

### 1. **IRS Direct Pay** (Free)
- **Website**: https://www.irs.gov/payments/direct-pay-with-bank-account
- No registration required
- Pay directly from your checking or savings account
- Available Monday-Saturday (midnight to 11:45 p.m. EST) and Sunday (7 a.m. to 11:45 p.m. EST)
- Can schedule payments up to 365 days in advance
- Can modify or cancel payments up to two business days before processing

### 2. **Electronic Federal Tax Payment System (EFTPS)** (Free)
- **Website**: https://www.eftps.gov
- Requires enrollment and PIN
- Available 24/7 online or by phone (800-555-4477)
- Can schedule payments up to a year in advance
- Best for businesses and frequent payers
- **Note**: EFTPS no longer accepts new users; existing users are being transitioned to IRS accounts

### 3. **IRS Online Account**
- Access through https://www.irs.gov
- Manage and make payments through your personal IRS account
- View balance, payment history, and manage payment plans

### 4. **Credit/Debit Card or Digital Wallet** (Fees Apply)
- Processed through third-party providers:
  - **Pay1040**: https://www.pay1040.com
  - **ACI Payments**: https://www.acipayments.com
- Debit card fee: ~$2.10-$2.15 flat fee
- Credit card fee: 1.75%-1.85% of payment (minimum $2.50)
- Also available through IRS2Go mobile app

### 5. **Electronic Funds Withdrawal (EFW)** (Free)
- Available when e-filing through tax software or tax preparer
- Direct debit from bank account when filing return
- Can schedule payment until return due date

### 6. **IRS2Go Mobile App** (Free App, Fees for Card Payments)
- Download from iOS/Android app stores
- Make payments via mobile version of Direct Pay (free) or by debit/credit card (fees apply)

---

## Important Update: Electronic Payment Mandate

A March 25, 2025 Executive Order requires federal tax payments to be made **electronically starting October 1, 2025**. Paper checks and money orders will no longer be accepted after September 30, 2025. Exceptions apply for those without banking access or in emergency situations.

---

## Steps to Pay Online (General)

1. Visit the IRS payments page: https://www.irs.gov/payments
2. Choose your preferred payment method
3. Verify your identity (SSN/ITIN, prior year tax info)
4. Enter payment amount and bank/card details
5. Schedule or submit payment
6. Save confirmation number for your records

Sources:
1. https://fiscal.treasury.gov/payments-to-government/electronic-federal-tax-payment-system-eftps
2. https://www.nerdwallet.com/taxes/learn/pay-irs-options
3. https://www.zinnerco.com/zinner-blog/executive-order-requires-electronic-payment-of-federal-tax
4. https://www.taxact.com/support/24794/2020/tax-due-payment-methods-federal-only
5. https://www.taxact.com/support/1142/2020/eftps-online-electronic-federal-tax-payment-system
6. https://www.hrblock.com/tax-payment-center/
7. https://www.taxact.com/support/357/2022/tax-due-payment-methods-federal-only
8. https://www.wallstreetmojo.com/electronic-federal-tax-payment-system/
